conventions: TypeScript + React 18 JSX, formatted by the repo Prettier config: single quotes, trailing commas, 2-space indent, 80-column wrap, arrow functions without parens around a single parameter.
Match the style of the file you edit; consistency within a package beats consistency across the repo.
No new source files in this change. Never change the Apache 2.0 copyright year of an existing file.
No new dependencies. Stay compatible with the React peer range ^17 || ^18: do not use useSyncExternalStore; use useState plus useEffect.
Public API members get TSDoc in plain adopter-facing language; the interface keeps its existing @public tag.
Tests are Jest describe/it with @testing-library/react; prefer screen with findBy*/getBy* over waitFor, no test ids, one thorough test with several assertions.

Changesets live in .changeset/<name>.md: YAML front matter mapping each quoted package name to its bump, a blank line, then one plain-language paragraph for adopters that names no internal code symbols (public API names such as useRouteRef and RouteResolutionApi are allowed).
API report files (report*.api.md) are regenerated with `yarn build:api-reports` after this change; never type them by hand.
Docs follow docs/contribute/doc-style-guide.md: present tense, active voice, address the reader as you, code style for package names and API names.

decisions.topic: Q-1: how route resolution tells consumers that its route information changed
decisions.choice: Add two optional public members to RouteResolutionApi in @backstage/frontend-plugin-api: subscribe?(listener: () => void): () => void, and isReady?(): boolean (false while the app is starting and only part of the routes are known).
rejected: Undocumented methods on the app's proxy object that both hooks duck-type, like the existing getRouteObjects TODO in AppRoot (a hidden cross-package contract no mock or adopter implementation can see)
A versioned value shared through a @backstage/version-bridge global singleton (more machinery for one bit of state)
decisions.reason: Optional members are typed, documented and mockable, keep every existing implementation valid (FR-5), and follow the pattern of other core APIs that expose change notifications; the cost is a frontend-plugin-api API report change.

decisions.topic: How the hooks re-resolve when route information changes
decisions.choice: Each useRouteRef keeps a numeric state counter; a useEffect on [routeResolutionApi, ready] subscribes via routeResolutionApi.subscribe when present and bumps the counter on each notification; the counter is added to the useMemo dependency array behind an `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` comment placed on the line directly above the array.
rejected: useSyncExternalStore (React 18 only, the peer range includes React 17)
Remounting root elements at finalization (changes tree instantiation, a non-goal)
decisions.reason: One notification causes exactly one state update and one re-render per consumer (FR-4), and an API without subscribe leaves the hook exactly as today (FR-5).

decisions.topic: Race between the first render and the subscription effect
decisions.choice: Each hook reads `ready = routeResolutionApi.isReady?.() ?? true` during render; the effect, right after subscribing, bumps the counter once if `isReady?.() ?? true` now differs from the render-time value.
decisions.reason: A notification that fires between render and subscribe would otherwise be lost and leave the bootstrap result in place.

decisions.topic: What the core-plugin-api bridge returns for a required ref that is unresolved before the app is ready
decisions.choice: A placeholder RouteFunc `(() => pathname) as RouteFunc<Params>` that links to the current location; once isReady is true (or the API has no isReady), an unresolved required ref throws `No path for ${routeRef}` exactly as today; optional refs keep returning undefined.
rejected: Throwing a promise to suspend (an element without its own boundary suspends app/root, which hides the sign-in page and deadlocks finalization)
Returning undefined for a required ref (callers type it as always defined and crash calling it)
decisions.reason: Root elements render during startup without an error box (AC-2) and switch to the real link on the next notification.

decisions.choice: RouteResolutionApiProxy.initialize takes a third argument `options: { ready: boolean }`; instantiateAndInitializePhaseTree passes `{ ready: !options.stopAtAttachment }`, because only the bootstrap phase stops at the session boundary.
rejected: Threading an explicit flag through createBootstrapApp and finalizeFromSessionState/finalizeFromBootstrapError (edits two more files for the same information)
decisions.reason: Keeps the fix in phaseApis.tsx; prepareSpecializedApp.tsx and treeLifecycle.tsx stay unchanged.

decisions.choice: Two changesets: one fix changeset with patch for @backstage/frontend-app-api (0.16.x), @backstage/frontend-plugin-api (0.18.x) and @backstage/core-plugin-api (1.12.x, fix only, no new API in that package); one patch changeset for @backstage/frontend-plugin-api describing the new optional RouteResolutionApi members.
decisions.reason: CLAUDE.md: patch below 1.0 even for additions, patch for a fix at 1.0 and above; separate messages because the API addition concerns one package only.

decisions.choice: No unit types packages/frontend-plugin-api/report.api.md; it is regenerated with `yarn build:api-reports` after the units are typed.
decisions.reason: NFR-4; a bugfix spec cannot hold a tooling unit.
